NAME: DMA controller verification plan
details: Block 9: dma_top with six dma_chan, dma_arbiter, dma_engine and dma_apb_slave. Source: GARUDA-DMA-SPEC-001, decisions D-16, D-21, and the map in garuda_system.yaml. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 5, 0x4000_5000. Channel n at 0x20 x n, GSTAT at 0x100. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 CR holds the channel control fields
details: Offset +0x00. EN bit 0, MODE 2:1, SINC 3, DINC 4, SIZE 6:5 with reset value 2 (word), IE_COMP 7, IE_ERR 8, bits 31:9 read 0. The register table gives the reset value as 0 while the SIZE field resets to 2; the spec table needs correcting. Spec 6.1.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_dma_top reset values, back-to-back writes

NAME: ral_access CR
details: Reset value 0x40, read-back of each field, reserved bits read 0, on all six channels.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: cg_dma_cr.x_fields
details: Every MODE with every SIZE, with SINC and DINC each 0 and 1, on every channel.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F02 A write of MODE 3 leaves MODE unchanged
details: The rest of the write still lands. Spec [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-6.1]

NAME: a_mode3_rejected
details: MODE is never 3.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F03 A write of SIZE 3 leaves SIZE unchanged
details: The specification lists 0, 1 and 2 and says nothing about 3. The RTL refuses it the same way as MODE 3; the specification needs that sentence. No transfer may start with an illegal AHB size.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: no check.

NAME: a_hsize_legal
details: HSIZE on the master port is only byte, halfword or word.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_cr.cp_size3
details: SIZE written 3 with EN 0 and with EN 1.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F04 SAR and DAR hold the addresses
details: Offsets +0x04 and +0x08, read-write, reset 0. They advance by the beat size after each successful beat when SINC or DINC is set, and a read shows the current value.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model, scoreboard). Today: tb_dma_top SAR/DAR advance checks

NAME: sb_addr
details: SAR and DAR compared with the reference model after every beat and at every read.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F05 CNT holds the beat count
details: Offset +0x0C, read-write, reset 0, 16 bits.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_dma_top CNT 0 and 1

NAME: ral_access CNT
details: Reset value, read-back, upper bits read 0.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: cg_dma_cnt.cp_cnt
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F06 STAT is read-only and consistent
details: Offset +0x10. REMAINING 15:0, ACTIVE 16, COMPLETE 17, ERROR 18, ERRPHASE 21:19. COMPLETE is never set with REMAINING non-zero. A write raises PSLVERR. Requirement R-6, spec [N-6.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-6], [N-6.2] DMA-4

NAME: a_remaining_complete_consistent
details: COMPLETE implies REMAINING is 0.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_active_implies_remaining
details: ACTIVE implies EN is set and REMAINING is not 0.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: sb_stat
details: Every STAT read compared with the model, including reads in every cycle of a transfer.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F07 ICLR clears COMPLETE and ERROR
details: Offset +0x14, write 1 to clear. Clearing ERROR also clears ERRPHASE. A flag that sets in the cycle of its own clear stays set.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top ICLR checks and the two ICLR sweeps

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: A flag setting in the cycle of its clear is 1 afterwards.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_iclr.x_bit_when
details: Each bit cleared before, in the cycle of, and after the flag sets.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F08 GSTAT summarises all six channels
details: Offset 0x100, read-only. Per-channel active, complete and error.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top GSTAT COMPLETE of one channel

NAME: sb_gstat
details: Compared with the six STAT values in the model at every read.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F09 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and change nothing
details: Channels 6 and 7 (0xC0 to 0xFC), +0x18 and +0x1C in each channel, 0x104 and above, unaligned offsets.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top - channel 6 and a write to STAT

NAME: sb_pslverr
details: PSLVERR compared with the model's address map on every access.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_dma_apb.x_unmapped_rw
details: Each unmapped range read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F10 Register access has no synchroniser latency
details: A read directly behind a write returns the new value, and each APB write gives exactly one hclk write strobe. PREADY is always high. Requirement R-3, decision D-16.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-3], DMA-5

NAME: a_no_cdc_latency
details: The hclk-side value equals the written value in the next pclk cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: a_one_strobe_per_write
details: One hclk write strobe per APB write.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F11 The six channels do not alias and reset disabled
details: A write to one channel changes that channel only. After reset every channel has EN 0 and CNT 0. Spec [N-9.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model) + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-9.2], back-to-back writes to different channels

NAME: ral_aliasing
details: Register model aliasing test over all 24 writable registers.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: a_reset_disabled
details: After reset no channel is enabled and the master port is idle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F12 Address and count written while the channel is running
details: Software owns SAR, DAR and CNT, so the write lands. What the running transfer then does is not stated; to be read from the RTL and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_dma_live.cp_write_while_active
details: SAR, DAR and CNT each written while ACTIVE.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F13 P2M - peripheral to memory
details: One beat per request, source fixed, destination advancing, data in order. Requirement R-2.
implementation_note: Method: sim (request agent, AHB slave agent, scoreboard). Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.1] [N-7.9]

NAME: sb_data
details: Every byte written to the destination equals the byte the model read from the source, in order.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F14 M2P - memory to peripheral
details: One beat per request, source advancing, destination fixed.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top [R-2] [N-7.1] [N-7.7]

NAME: sb_data
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F15 M2M - memory to memory
details: Runs without a request, one beat each time the channel wins arbitration. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.5], all channels and sizes

NAME: sb_data
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_dma_xfer.x_mode_size_ch
details: Every mode with every size on every channel (54 bins). Today only M2M is swept over size.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F16 A beat is a read then a write as two SINGLE transfers
details: No bursts - HBURST 0, HTRANS never SEQ or BUSY. Spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.2]; AHB protocol checker on the master port

NAME: a_single_only
details: HBURST is 0 and HTRANS is IDLE or NONSEQ on the master port.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: ahb_checker
details: AHB-Lite protocol checker on M3 - 0 violations.
implementation_note: tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v, bound today.

NAME: F17 Byte and halfword beats use the right lanes at every address offset
details: SIZE byte at offsets 0 to 3 and halfword at 0 and 2. A halfword or word at an unaligned address is not covered by the specification; to be decided and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top byte beats at one pair of offsets

NAME: cg_dma_xfer.x_size_offset
details: Byte at each of 4 source and 4 destination offsets; halfword at 0 and 2; unaligned halfword and word.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_data
details: Model compare on byte lanes.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F18 Exactly CNT beats are transferred
details: Including CNT 1, CNT 65535, and CNT 0, which transfers nothing and drops EN. Spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top CNT 0 and CNT 1

NAME: sb_beats
details: Beat count compared with the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F19 Completion
details: COMPLETE sets, ACTIVE clears, hardware clears EN and REMAINING is 0, all in one cycle. Requirement R-6, spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-6] [N-7.3]

NAME: a_remaining_complete_consistent
details: Covered by F06.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F20 EN cleared by software in the middle of a transfer
details: The channel stops at a beat boundary with no COMPLETE, no ERROR and no interrupt, and REMAINING, SAR and DAR agree with the beats done. Setting EN again continues from there.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top EN cleared mid-transfer

NAME: cg_dma_live.cp_stop_phase
details: EN cleared during the read, during the write, and between beats; then re-enabled.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_data
details: Model compare across the stop and the restart.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: C Request and acknowledge
details: Spec 7.3, decisions D-16, D-21.

NAME: F21 One beat per request assertion
details: A request that is visible for two hclk cycles gives one beat. Spec [N-7.10].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.10]

NAME: a_one_beat_per_req
details: No second beat on a channel until its request has fallen and risen again.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_req.cp_req_width
details: Request high for one pclk, several, and held until the acknowledge.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F22 The acknowledge is one pclk wide and follows the completed beat
details: Two hclk cycles, so the pclk-side peripheral always sees it. Spec [N-7.8], decision D-16.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.8]

NAME: a_ack_width
details: Every dma_ack pulse is exactly two hclk cycles and aligned to pclk.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F23 A request withdrawn before the grant gives no beat and no acknowledge
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.12] [N-7.7]

NAME: cg_dma_req.cp_withdrawn
details: Request dropped while waiting behind a higher channel.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_beats
details: No beat recorded by the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F24 A failed beat does not use up the request
details: After an error and a re-arm the still-pending request is served. Defect DMA-8.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top DMA-8 check

NAME: sb_beats
details: Model compare after re-arm.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F25 A request on a disabled channel is ignored
details: Also a request that arrives in the cycle EN is set, and one already high when EN is set.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_dma_req.cp_req_vs_en
details: Request before, in the cycle of, and after EN is set.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: D Arbitration
details: Spec 7.4.

NAME: F26 Fixed priority between channels
details: Channel 0 highest, then 4, 1, 3, 2, and 5 lowest. Requirement R-4, spec 6.3.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-4] all 15 pairs

NAME: a_priority
details: When two channels are eligible at a beat boundary the higher priority one is granted.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_arb.cp_pair
details: All 15 pairs requesting together; three and more together.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F27 A beat is never split between channels
details: The channel is latched at the read and cannot change until the write completes. Spec [N-7.11].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.11]

NAME: a_beat_atomic
details: The granted channel does not change between a read and its write.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_one_channel
details: At most one channel is in the engine at any time.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F28 A low-priority channel under continuous higher requests
details: Documented as starved while the higher channels keep requesting. To show - it resumes as soon as they stop and loses nothing. Spec [N-7.12].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top - channel 2 starved by channel 0

NAME: cg_dma_arb.cp_starved_cycles
details: A low channel waiting 1, 10 and 100 or more beats.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F29 A bus error on the read or on the write
details: ERROR sets, ERRPHASE records which, EN and ACTIVE clear, and REMAINING, SAR and DAR freeze at the failing beat. Spec [N-7.13], [N-7.15].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.13], [N-7.15]

NAME: a_errphase
details: ERRPHASE is 1 after a read error and 2 after a write error.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: a_freeze_on_error
details: REMAINING, SAR and DAR do not change while ERROR is set and EN is 0.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_err.x_phase_mode_beat
details: Read and write errors in each mode, on the first, a middle and the last beat.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F30 An error stops only its own channel
details: The others carry on and there is no global error state. Requirement R-8, spec [N-7.14].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-8] [N-7.14]

NAME: a_error_isolated
details: An error on one channel changes no state of another channel.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_err.cp_error_ch
details: An error on each channel while another channel is mid-transfer.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F31 No automatic retry
details: The master port goes idle and EN stays clear until firmware re-arms. Spec [N-7.16].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.16]

NAME: a_no_retry
details: No transfer from a channel between its error and the next write of EN.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F32 ISRAM and boot ROM addresses give a clean error
details: On every channel, as source or destination, and no transfer ever addresses them. Requirement R-9, spec [N-7.20], [N-7.21].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-9]

NAME: a_no_isram
details: HADDR on the master port is never in 0x0... or 0x1... while HTRANS is NONSEQ.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F33 Completion and error interrupts are levels per channel
details: dma_complete rises with COMPLETE when IE_COMP is set and stays until ICLR; the same for dma_error with IE_ERR. With the enable clear the flag still sets. Requirement R-5, spec [N-7.3], [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-5], [N-7.3], [N-7.4]

NAME: a_irq_level
details: dma_complete equals COMPLETE and IE_COMP, dma_error equals ERROR and IE_ERR, on every channel in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dma_irq.x_ch_kind_ie
details: Each channel, completion and error, with the enable 0, 1, and set after the flag.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F34 A software write in the cycle hardware clears EN
details: Hardware wins the EN bit; the rest of the write lands. Requirement R-7, spec [N-7.17], [N-7.18].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [R-7] and the CR-write sweep

NAME: a_hw_wins_en
details: After a collision EN is 0.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_sw_write_lands
details: After a collision the software-owned fields hold the written value.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/dma/dma_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F35 The same rule for every hardware-owned bit
details: EN, COMPLETE, ERROR, REMAINING and ACTIVE. Spec [N-7.19]. Today EN, COMPLETE, ERROR and ERRPHASE collisions are swept.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_dma_top [N-7.19] and the ICLR sweeps - four of the five

NAME: cg_dma_coll.cp_bit
details: A software write coinciding with the hardware update of each of the five bits.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: G With the rest of the chip
details: Checked at chip level and by connectivity checks.

NAME: F36 Each peripheral request reaches its own channel
details: Channel 0 SPI master, 1 I2C, 2 UART0, 3 UART1, 4 SPI slave, 5 UART2, and each acknowledge goes back to the same peripheral. Spec 6.3 as amended by INT-1.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level + connectivity. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c

NAME: conn_dma_req
details: Bound assertions at the SoC top for the six request and six acknowledge wires.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F37 Completion reaches CLIC IDs 1 to 6 and error reaches 8 to 13
details: The spec text and the interface table still say 7 to 12; they need correcting to the map after INT-2.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level + connectivity. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c takes all twelve

NAME: conn_irq_map
details: Shared with the CLIC plan F23.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F38 DMA traffic alongside the core
details: The DMA is the highest-priority bus master. A long M2M transfer slows the core but must not corrupt it or starve it for ever. Spec [N-7.5], [N-7.6].
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level (scenario). Today: sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c and t_chip_irq.c run short transfers

NAME: t_chip_dma_traffic
details: A 16384-beat M2M transfer while the core runs a self-checking loop with interrupts.
implementation_note: sw/chip. Planned.

NAME: F39 A peripheral to memory transfer end to end
details: UART receive into DSRAM by DMA from the pins.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_uart.c uses DMA on one UART

NAME: t_chip_uart
details: UART receive by DMA.
implementation_note: sw/chip/t_chip_uart.c, passing.

NAME: H Clock reset and power
details: Spec section 9.

NAME: F40 Two clocks and no synchroniser
details: The register file on pclk is read by hclk logic on shared edges. Spec [N-9.1].
implementation_note: Method: static + sim. Today: HAL reports the boundary when the block is linted alone; waived in flow/2_static/hal_waivers.txt

NAME: hal_cdc
details: No crossing reported at chip level.
implementation_note: flow/2_static.

details: The specification says a disabled channel receives no clock [N-9.3]. The RTL has no clock gate in rtl/dma. One of the two has to change; logged for the owner.
implementation_note: Method: review. Today: no check.

details: Spec against RTL.
